insights.title: Canon-aware benchmark
insights.detail: The live corpus covers 25 books and 1,332,482 words, but it still clusters around a public-domain Anglo-American canon. Treat it as an auditable benchmark, not a universal map of the field.

insights.title: Meaningful book neighborhoods
insights.detail: Similarity signals already produce interpretable neighbors such as Oz-to-Oz and Little Women-to-Anne of Green Gables style adjacency, which is the right shape for discovery and list extension.

insights.title: Character-driven corpus
insights.detail: Recurring names and dense entity surfaces make the dashboard especially useful for character-centered classroom comparison and catalog storytelling.

insights.title: Windowing matters
insights.detail: Book length varies enough that sentiment and theme views should be read as chunked comparisons rather than one-number summaries.
